protocol.data_order: CPU randperm seeded with 42+epoch-1, independent of model RNG
protocol.augmentation: paired original and random-yaw copy; both gyro and acceleration XY rotated together with velocity target
protocol.selection: minimum unaugmented full-validation velocity MSE; first ties; best-ATE checkpoint diagnostic only
protocol.reconstruction: same official-style reconstruct() for both models
protocol.trajectory_metrics: official coordinate-wise ATE and 60s RTE, sequence-macro mean
protocol.network_batch_size: 2*anchor_batch_size; originals then rotated copies in one forward
protocol.rotations: one independent angle per anchor, uniform [0,2*pi), FP32
protocol.rotation_rng: CPU torch.Generator seed=20261027+epoch-1; generated in epoch sample order before training
protocol.gradient: both prediction branches receive gradients; no detach
protocol.save_checkpoints: best MSE (primary), best ATE (diagnostic), last; never choose on test metrics
protocol.initialization: fresh CNN-GRU seed=42, same as old controlled CNN-GRU; not fine-tuning
protocol.evaluation: native training BN, single and fixed C4; no calibration or test-time training
